about: PHIA objective questions (github.com/yahskapar/personal-health-insights-agent, CC BY-NC 4.0) mapped to AskWearables QuerySpecs. Question text and answers are not stored here; ids are <synthetic user>:<row in data/auto_eval/<persona>_final_v2.csv>. See eval/phia/NOTES.md.

extract_kinds.l2.value: the finding's level 2 value (aggregate: the statistic; threshold_check: number of days meeting the condition)
extract_kinds.sessions: the level 3 session list: keep sessions whose provider activity name equals `title` (if set), take `field` (minutes = end - start), optionally slice/index in time order, then reduce
